svg.aria-label: The photovoltaic module inspection image as a dense-detection primitive. Left: three imaging channels of the same module — electroluminescence (EL), a near-infrared image of the forward-biased cell grid that shows cracks, inactive areas and finger interruptions; thermal infrared (IR) from a UAV, which shows hotspots, open substrings and bypass-diode faults at low resolution; and visible RGB, which shows soiling, shading, glass breakage and the plant layout. Right: a ladder of six output layers from L0 plant map and module georeference, L1 module or cell normal versus anomaly, L2 boxes per defect, L3 pixel masks of cracks and inactive area, L4 fault class and root cause, to L5 power loss and a repair or warranty decision.
svg.title: The PV inspection image: three channels, six output layers
svg.text: The PV module inspection image: three imaging channels, six output layers
Same module, three physics. The asset owner needs watts lost and a repair or warranty call, not a box.

g.text: EL · electroluminescence (NIR, forward-biased)
Grey-level cell grid; dark = inactive silicon.
Sees: micro-cracks, inactive areas, finger breaks,
contact / solder faults, PID, corrosion.
ELPV · PVEL-AD (36.5K, 8 cls) · UCF-EL · SCDD/E-SCDD
IR · thermal infrared (UAV, under load)
Low-res, low-contrast heat map of whole rows.
Sees: hotspots, open / shorted substrings,
bypass-diode and junction-box overheating.
RGB · visible (UAV, aerial, satellite)
High-res, but most cell defects are invisible.
Sees: soiling, shading, glass breakage, debris,
and where every module is (plant map).
orthomosaics · SAM / SAM 3 PV footprint mapping

svg.text: No single channel sees every fault: EL needs current injection (night / dark tent),
IR needs sunlight and load, RGB sees the surface only. Fusion is the open problem.

g.text: L0 · plant map, module ID, georeference
SfM + GPS; RGB-IR orthomosaic; SAM-family footprints
L1 · normal vs anomaly per module / cell
PatchCore-style, iterative AE (EES 2026), AA-CLIP
L2 · boxes per defect
YOLO11 / YOLO26n (NMS-free), PV-YOLO, RF-DETR on IR
L3 · pixel masks: cracks, inactive area
Mask2Former / ConvNeXt-V2, STC-Net topology refinement
L4 · fault class + root cause
GEPFNet, JEFFNet (JEPA ViT + CNN), REVL-PV reasoning
L5 · power loss, repair / warranty decision
mask → inactive-area proxy → % loss (STC-Net, Type-C study)

svg.text: Public benchmarks are strongest at L2 (EL boxes) and L4 (IR crops).
L0 and L5 are what plant operators pay for, and least benchmarked.
